name: scenario_1039
description: The user attended a business expo and took photos of various business cards, badges, and promotional materials. They want to organize the contact information they collected.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: I've got a bunch of photos from the expo. Please review all of these and filter out the ones that clearly show an email address or a phone number. I want to add them to my contacts. If it's a company and I already have them saved, just update their existing entry. If it's a person, create a brand new contact for them.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to review the provided images, filter for the ones that show an email address or phone number, and add them to your contacts. Tell it to update the existing contact if it's a company you already have saved, but to create a brand new contact if it's a person. If the assistant asks for confirmation on which ones to process, tell it to proceed with the ones that clearly display contact info. Once the contacts are added or updated, move on to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: Now check those same images for the contacts you just processed. If any of their images also show a website URL, update their contact entry to include that website.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to check the images corresponding to the contacts it just added or updated. If any of those images contain a website URL, ask it to update their contact information to include that URL. If the assistant asks for confirmation on the extracted URLs, tell it they look correct and to proceed with the updates. Once the updates are complete, move on to the next step.

ROUND 3
Query: Finally, find the person whose image mentions 'Socialinis verslas' as their field of activity. Send them an email saying it was great to meet them, and explicitly mention that I'd love to learn more about their company.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to find the person associated with the 'Socialinis verslas' field of activity from the images, and send them an email. The email should express that it was great to meet them and explicitly mention the name of their company exactly as shown in the image. The assistant should notice there are multiple contacts with that person's name and ask which one to use. When it asks, clarify that it should use the email address explicitly shown in the image. Once the email is sent, you can end the conversation.

You have 6 images available to share with the agent using the send_message_with_image tool.
IMPORTANT: Image IDs are ZERO-INDEXED integers (0, 1, 2, ...). Do NOT add 1 to the IDs.
Available image IDs: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
Image mapping:
  image_1.jpg -> image ID 0
  image_2.jpg -> image ID 1
  image_3.jpg -> image ID 2
  image_4.jpg -> image ID 3
  image_5.jpg -> image ID 4
  image_6.jpg -> image ID 5

entity_data.subject: Great to meet you!
entity_data.body:
Hi Milda,

It was great to meet you at the expo! I'd love to learn more about your company, Lietuviška vasara.

Best,
Ashlee

task_completion_criteria: Update the existing 'Wellcome Trust' contact to include the email 'publishing@wellcome.ac.uk' and the website 'www.wellcome.ac.uk/bigpic' (or similar), create a new contact for 'Milda Knašytė' with email 'mildakn@gmail.com', create a new contact for 'ACCTivate!' with phone '(866) 877-1311' and website 'www.acctivate.com', and send an email to Milda Knašytė at 'mildakn@gmail.com' stating that it was great to meet them and mentioning their company 'Lietuviška vasara'.
